gate: component paper: proposes and evaluates a decoder design (spoken-speech-trained CSP+SVM applied to imagined-speech EEG)
prep: no prep/ directory and no prep.done; plan, audits and comparators built by the writer from published topic tables
changed_note: M04 carries the contribution: imagined speech decoded at use time by a classifier trained on spoken-speech EEG; M01 (spoken speech as training-time action) and M03 (10 spoken trials per class) are the same design seen from training and are folded into the M04 section.

inherited.M01: Spoken-speech EEG of the same words (folded into M04)
inherited.M03: Within-subject training; full or 10 spoken trials per class; no fine-tuning (folded into M04)
inherited.M05: 64-channel active-electrode EEG, 10-10 system (Korea University imagined-speech / visual-imagery datasets, ref. [1])
inherited.M06: CSP filters + SVM (classic EEG BCI lineage)
inherited.M11: Instructed paradigm labels; imagery cannot be verified (authors' caveat)

topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table: studies that apply a decoder trained only on overt (or attempted overt) speech to mouthed, silently articulated, inner or imagined speech without retraining, any signal; studies that also train on silent data count when they report an overt-only condition; alignment-only use, whisper conversion and perception-to-inner transfer excluded; versions once.
topics.metric: transfer accuracy against within-mode training and against chance

topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table: studies that classify imagined, covert or inner speech from scalp EEG; design compared is whether accuracy is referenced against chance (stated chance level, above-chance test, or permutation null); full-text pattern counts are upper bounds; versions once.
